lddmcoreeventdefs.h contains the subset of DXGK (Microsoft-Windows-DxgKrnl /
LDDMCore) ETW provider GUIDs, keywords, and event IDs used by the library.

The values originate from LDDMCore.man, which ships with GPUView in the Windows
Performance Toolkit (Windows ADK).
